instruction: Set the editor font size to 16 in VS Code's settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VS Code settings, searched for python missing imports setting, found python.analysis.diagnosticSeverityOverrides, opened settings.json via command palette, typed the correct JSON content with reportMissingImports set to none, but failed to save the file before evaluation ended.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VS Code settings UI, search settings by keyword, use command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P), navigate to Preferences: Open User Settings (JSON), edit settings.json with correct JSON syntax
metadata.failure_analysis: Model correctly edited settings.json with the right nested JSON structure but did not save the file. The unsaved indicator (dot in tab title) was visible in the final screenshot. The evaluator read the file from disk which still contained old content.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single top-level setting (editor.fontSize) instead of nested diagnosticSeverityOverrides object. This tests the same settings-editing capability but with a simpler value structure, reducing the chance of JSON formatting errors.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing editor.fontSize to 16 in VS Code settings.json. Evaluator uses check_json_settings to verify the setting value in the saved file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches VS Code user settings from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json via get_vm_file
Metric check_json_settings correctly accesses expected['expected'] to get the rules dict {'editor.fontSize': 16}, matching how the framework passes rules when expected.type='rule'
Metric parses the JSON settings file and verifies that editor.fontSize equals 16, which directly matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: instruction requires only setting editor font size to 16, and the evaluator checks exactly this
No postconfig needed since the evaluator reads the file from disk rather than from UI state

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
